title: TCGA Expression Explorer
description: A static web tool that shows the expression of one gene, in one TCGA cohort, under all three generations of TCGA gene-level RNA-seq quantification side by side, on the same specimens, optionally split by published molecular-subtype schemes. This record archives the source code; the underlying matrices are deposited separately (doi:10.5281/zenodo.22670234).
